headline: Delhi Police Issue Official List Of 'Camera-Friendly' Facial Expressions For Officers Confronting Protesters
body: Officers are now instructed to cycle through 'thoughtful contemplation' and 'slightly amused skepticism' during demonstrations to prevent their natural resting grumpiness from being clipped for viral social media content. The mandate specifically forbids the classic 'baffled squint' which officials admit is currently fueling 40% of the city's protest-related engagement metrics.
caption: Police now have a strict 'no frowning' policy to stop you from going viral on their watch. Which look are you choosing for your next protest? #DelhiPolice #SocialMedia #ProtestEtiquette #ViralTrends (satire)
igHook: Which of these new mandatory expressions do you think will be the most difficult for a tired constable to pull off?

sourceHeadline.title: 'Your angry face is their content': Delhi Police told how not to respond to new-gen protesters | India News
